description_md:
As Decided retrieves, validates, and checks relationships between engineering
decisions already stored in a local repository. It runs the native Rust
engine on the Pilot node: neither Pilot nor As Decided receives, hosts, or
indexes the repository.

The Pilot surface is deliberately read-only and deterministic. Every call
names the repository it reads, and there is no arbitrary command passthrough.

methods.name: asdecided.retrieve
methods.summary: Retrieve the decisions and related context governing a task from a local repository.

methods.name: asdecided.validate
methods.summary: Validate decision artifacts in a local repository without writing a cache.

methods.name: asdecided.relationships
methods.summary: Inspect and validate relationships between decision artifacts in a local repository.

methods.name: asdecided.help
methods.summary: Discovery: every method with params, kind, and latency class.

notes: Initial Pilot App Store candidate using the native As Decided v0.26.2 engine.

product_demo.title: Ground work in the decisions already on this machine
product_demo.when_to_use: When an agent needs to retrieve or check the engineering decisions governing work in a local repository.

quickstart.goal: Retrieve the decisions governing a task
quickstart.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.asdecided asdecided.retrieve '{"task":"Can I hard-delete a closed user account?","repository":"/Users/me/project"}'
quickstart.expect: A deterministic JSON grounding bundle containing the governing decisions and source paths.

examples.title: Validate the decision corpus
examples.expect: JSON validation results; valid and invalid artifact counts are explicit.

examples.title: Check relationship integrity
examples.expect: JSON relationship validation results with any broken references identified.

gotchas: Replace /Users/me/project with an absolute repository path under the Pilot user's home directory; the path is never uploaded.
The Pilot app is read-only: mutation, migration, scaffolding, sharing, and arbitrary CLI execution are not exposed.
